MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 9

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 64

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 13
   D. 12

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

9. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

19. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

20. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

21. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

24. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

25. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

26. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

27. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

28. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

29. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

30. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
